payload.title: Measure the actual Frank v0.1 target VPS and co-resident runtime contention
payload.work_clay: On the current Hostinger target VPS / digital-retina, capture an exact non-secret host identity and resource baseline, then execute matched service/runtime measurements that represent the real v0.1 deployment. Record kernel/OS/arch, CPU topology/frequency/cgroup limits, RAM, swap, storage/filesystem/free-space and safe I/O characteristics, network/listener boundaries, llama.cpp/model/mmproj identity, UnifiedDB/EAP placement and GitHub runner/service placement. Measure cold/warm model load, prompt/decode throughput, Qwen3.5-4B abliterated Q4_K_M + mmproj fit when current artifacts are available, Retina visual encode path, EAP compile/end-to-end path, service startup/readiness, crash/restart/last-known-good restoration and full resource shadows. Run a contention factorial: TARGET_IDLE, FRANK_QWEN_ONLY, FRANK_QWEN_PLUS_EAP, GITHUB_RUNNER_ONLY, FRANK_PLUS_RUNNER, and FRANK_PLUS_EAP_PLUS_RUNNER using bounded non-destructive workloads. Separate runtime/service effects from cross-repository runner transport. Use cgroup/systemd/affinity or priority isolation only as measured candidates, not assumptions.
payload.reason_clay: The project owner has changed the final v0.1 target from a later Andreas-local-PC run to the already verified Hostinger VPS. Existing evidence proves a real 4B Qwen-family model runs there on four logical CPUs, but exact RAM/swap/storage/GPU facts are not yet canonically captured and the same host also runs the self-hosted GitHub Actions runner. Therefore target performance, memory fit and CI-vs-Frank interference are now release-critical unknowns rather than remote-lane details.
payload.completion_clay: A reproducible TARGET_VPS_RUNTIME_BASELINE_RECEIPT binds exact host/runtime/model/state hashes and reports all observed host resources, target-service startup/recovery, Qwen3.5-4B+mmproj fit or exact blocker, p50/p95/p99 prompt/decode/visual/EAP/end-to-end latency, CPU/RSS/swap/storage/network shadows and the matched co-residency contention matrix. It states whether the GitHub runner can coexist safely with interactive Frank service load, whether isolation is required, and which resource envelope becomes the v0.1 acceptance baseline. Unknown hardware facts may become measured facts; no planned GPU/storage VPS values may be substituted. Disposition: TARGET_BASELINE_ESTABLISHED, REVISE_RESOURCE_ISOLATION, TARGET_HOST_BLOCKED, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
controls: Frank alone vs runner alone vs co-resident
frozen visual fixture vs live sensor transport where available
payload.executor_policy: This is final-target characterization and may run on the target VPS even while BASE is in progress, but it must not destabilize active services. Prefer read-only host inspection and bounded benchmarks. Preserve service health before/after. Do not launch paid training. Do not infer GPU/RAM/storage from planned hardware. If current target resources are insufficient, report the exact blocker and compare architecture/resource-isolation remedies before proposing a target-host change.
